notes.title: Various bug fixes
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone for reporting all the bugs and sorry for the mistakes! Here is the update list:

Fix: activating missing translation blocked
Fix: garbled text for the Game Over message
Fix: glitched out graphics for collision tiles
Fix: octopus boss failing to react to hits by harpoon
Fix: octopus boss HP instant depletion

notes.title: Game controls, System controls and Technical notes
notes.notes:
[b] Game controls:[/b]
Joypad is autodetected.
Keyboard:
Cursor left/right = move,
Cursor down = ducking (slightly extends sword reach!) or ladders down,
Cursor up = ladders up,
a,s,d = action buttons.
For customization, see system controls.

[b] System controls:[/b]
Esc = Cabinet menu (exit game, change controls),
F10 = change video mode (resets game!),
F11 = fullscreen/windowed mode,
\ = CRT filter toggle,
[] = CRT brightness.

[b] Technical notes:[/b]
The game has a few screen modes, if the default one renders incorrectly (at the start of the level there is a thin gap between tiles in the middle of the screen, or other tiles render with a gap between them etc), switch the video mode by pressing F10 (this also rests the game!).

Very rarely the second jump does not get registered properly. Also some controllers get a slight delay - please use keyboard if this happens on your computer.

If the framerate starts to drop, try turning off the CRT filter, lowering the resolution and/or closing other programs and restarting.

support at nekomuragames com
